newsitem.title: CHINA: China to invest 200 bln yuan in western railways.
newsitem.headline: China to invest 200 bln yuan in western railways.

text.p: China is to invest more than 200 billion yuan ($24.1 billion) in building 16 railway lines in its backward western regions in the next century, the China Daily said on Wednesday.
Despite heavy government investment, rail services in China's resource-rich west remained limited compared with eastern parts of the country, it said.
Western regions covered 55 percent of China's total area but had only 24 percent of the nation's railway lines, it said.
The northwestern regions of Xinjiang and Ningxia had only one railway line each and there was still no line available to Tibet, it said.
Difficult terrain, natural disasters and harsh weather conditions made construction of railways in the west difficult and costly, it said.
Seven of this year's 15 new railway projects were targeted for western regions, it said, but gave no further details.
